name: Other armed conflicts
summary: Afghan–Pakistan border clashes continue after Moscow talks ended without agreement
state: Clashes between Pakistani forces and the Afghan Taliban continued along the border through late October after talks in Moscow ended without agreement, amid reports of Pakistani outreach to anti-Taliban groups (Long War Journal, 29 Oct). Searches on 6 Nov found no new interstate war, attack on a capital or mass-atrocity warning in a conflict not tracked elsewhere.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Afghanistan, Pakistan's border areas and southern Ethiopia.
